summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an additional closing under an existing Securities Purchase Agreement with Ascent Partners Fund LLC. The company issued a $1,111,111.11 Senior Secured Convertible Promissory Note (12% interest, maturity April 20, 2027) and a warrant for 3,333,333 common shares at $0.50 per share, for $1,000,000 aggregate purchase price. The note is secured by substantially all assets. This is a routine debt financing with conversion features, not a special situation.
